FIELDS.NAME: Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center is a modern medical and dental facility dedicated to providing comprehensive care to our community. Our core operations include routine dental check-ups, preventative care, and various specialized treatments, all performed by highly qualified professionals. Our state-of-the-art facility is designed to ensure patient comfort and safety, adhering strictly to both state and federal regulations. We implement a rigorous employee training program on hazardous material handling and emergency procedures, which is a critical component in minimizing workplace risks. The practice is equipped with proper ventilation systems and secure storage for all materials, ensuring compliance with OSHA guidelines. We prioritize patient privacy and security, utilizing secure electronic health records and safeguarding all patient information in compliance with data privacy regulations. Our practice also conducts regular risk assessments and safety reviews to enhance operational efficiency and mitigate potential hazards. Additionally, we maintain professional liability coverage independent of our business operations to ensure comprehensive protection against malpractice claims.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2022, a slip and fall incident occurred in the waiting area due to a wet floor after a cleaning event, resulting in a claim of $5,000. The incident was investigated, corrective measures were implemented, and the claim has been closed with no ongoing liability.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class IV Safe, UL Listed, Fire-resistant, Grade 1, for secure storage of vital records and sensitive materials.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and monitored alarm system in place to deter theft and vandalism.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Actual cash value of personal property: $350,000
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The practice adheres to all safety protocols and regulations regarding hazardous materials and ensures compliance with OSHA guidelines.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center does not sponsor any athletic teams. The focus of the practice is primarily on providing medical and dental services to the community.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Our office ensures compliance by verifying all certificates before subcontractors are engaged.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes in connection with this or any other property. The practice maintains strict ethical standards and compliance with all legal regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. The practice maintains good standing with its insurance provider.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff members are directly employed and trained by the practice to ensure quality care and compliance with operational standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center carries Workers Compensation coverage for its employees to ensure compliance with state regulations and protect against workplace injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center also owns and operates Bright Smile Orthodontics, providing complementary dental services to the community.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center does not have any other insurance policies with this company. The practice maintains its primary liability coverage for operations and professional services.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus solely on providing medical and dental services to patients.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center does not rent or loan equipment to others, ensuring that all equipment is used solely within the practice to maintain safety and compliance standards.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – There have been no foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens within the past five years for Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center. The practice has maintained financial stability during this period.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as all materials are managed in compliance with safety regulations and stored appropriately.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center does not have any exposure to catastrophes as our operations focus on providing routine medical and dental care, with strict adherence to safety protocols and regulations. We actively implement risk management practices to mitigate potential hazards.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The practice maintains stringent hiring protocols and compliance with legal standards to mitigate such risks.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Bright Smile Dental & Medical Center has no uncorrected fire code violations and actively maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations.

The appointment scheduling was easy, and I was seen right on time. Highly recommend this practice for both dental and medical needs!
